title: Tenant-scope public settings and cache
goal: Prevent cross-tenant reuse of public settings and process-local cache entries in multi mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi mode queries use tenant scope
humanGate: Maintainer confirmation of tenant isolation contract

humanGateDecision.authorization: Maintainer instruction 2026-09-23: authorize the agent to complete the remaining A-round items directly, including confirming each task's human gate.
humanGateDecision.decision: Tenant isolation contract confirmed as implemented: /setting/public returns global(tenant_id=0) merged with the current tenant override in multi mode, global-only in compat, and the process cache is tenant-namespaced. Anonymous requests keep the global view because the public route does not mount TenantContextMiddleware; widening that is explicitly not approved.

closeoutNote: 2026-09-23: closed out. commands.json + review.md written for .harness/evidence/2026-09-22-tenant-public-settings-scope/; verification re-run on the integrated working tree — the 5 public-settings isolation tests PASS with TenantCacheIsolation red on the pre-fix implementation, confirming this closed a real cross-tenant cache leak. Remaining: the humanGate below is a maintainer action; nothing was merged and no gate was bypassed.
statusNote: 2026-09-22: implemented; 2026-09-23: closed out with commands.json + review.md and re-verified on the integrated tree. GetPublicSettings now applies tenantScope with tenant-override resolution (multi) and global-only compat; publicCache is a tenant-namespaced map; the public handler binds the request tenant context; a new pubsub watcher drops process setting caches cross-instance (channel shared with the existing publisher). 5 regression tests cover A/B isolation, cache leak, compat, and invalidation. Evidence: .harness/evidence/2026-09-22-tenant-public-settings-scope/summary.md. Gaps (updated 2026-09-23): dual-instance runtime validation was still not run locally (single instance; the cross-instance mechanism reuses the auth watcher's pubsub channel); the maintainer gate is satisfied via humanGateDecision. go test -race on modules/system/config/setting and pkg/tenant passed with no data races.
